title: Thai-Style Grilled Lentil Cakes
description: A flavorful and healthy dish inspired by the streets of Thailand, featuring grilled lentil cakes infused with aromatic spices.
instructions: Soak the red lentils in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the lentils, then mash them in a bowl.
Add the cooked aromatic rice, saudi Arabian spice blend, grill seasoning, onion, garlic, and eggplant to the bowl. Mix well.
Divide the mixture into 4-6 portions, depending on desired cake size.
Shape each portion into a patty.
Heat a non-stick skillet or grill over medium heat.
Add 2-3 patties to the skillet or grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve the grilled lentil cakes hot with your favorite Thai-style sauce.
